title: Trump Files Ethics Complaints Against NY AG Over Trump University Probe
synopsis: Trump filed ethics complaints and publicly accused New York Attorney General Eric Schneiderman of improper conduct after the state sued Trump University for fraud. The move sought to paint the investigation as political while escalating the legal and public pressure campaign. Critics described it as intimidation against a law‑enforcement official overseeing a case involving Trump’s business.

title: Trump Calls for “Total and Complete Shutdown” of Muslims Entering the U.S.
synopsis: During the 2016 campaign, Trump issued a statement calling for a “total and complete shutdown” of Muslims entering the United States. The proposal framed an entire religion as a security threat and became a signature example of religious discrimination rhetoric. It set the stage for later policy efforts targeting Muslim-majority countries.

title: Trump Backs Muslim Registry and Mosque Surveillance Proposals
synopsis: Trump voiced support for a database of Muslims in the United States and for expanded surveillance of mosques after the 2015 Paris attacks. Civil‑liberties groups and legal experts warned the idea would violate constitutional protections and stigmatize an entire faith community. The comments intensified fears of state‑sanctioned religious profiling.

title: Trump Says He’d Bring Back Waterboarding and “A Hell of a Lot Worse”
synopsis: On the campaign trail, Trump said he would bring back waterboarding and use “a hell of a lot worse,” signaling support for torture. The remarks rejected legal prohibitions and international human‑rights norms. Critics warned the statements normalized war‑crime rhetoric.

title: Trump Attacks Judge Gonzalo Curiel as “Mexican” in Trump University Case
synopsis: Trump attacked federal Judge Gonzalo Curiel by arguing that Curiel’s Mexican heritage made him biased in the Trump University fraud case. Legal experts across the spectrum condemned the remarks as racist and an attack on judicial independence. The comments politicized the courts and echoed ethnic‑based disqualification arguments.

title: Trump Attacks Gold Star Khan Family After DNC Speech
synopsis: After Khizr Khan criticized him at the Democratic National Convention, Trump attacked the Gold Star father and suggested his wife was not “allowed to speak.” The public dispute with a family whose son was killed in Iraq drew bipartisan condemnation. The episode became a defining moment in the 2016 campaign for its cruelty and divisiveness.

title: “Second Amendment People” Remark Suggests Violence Against Clinton
synopsis: At a rally, Trump said that if Hillary Clinton appointed Supreme Court justices, “Second Amendment people” might be able to do something, a remark widely interpreted as a suggestion of political violence. Critics, including members of both parties, condemned the comment. The episode reinforced concerns about incitement rhetoric during the campaign.

title: Trump Refuses to Denounce David Duke in CNN Interview
synopsis: In a CNN interview, Trump declined to immediately condemn former KKK leader David Duke and white supremacist groups, saying he needed to “look at the groups.” The hesitation triggered widespread backlash and raised alarms about courting extremist support. It reinforced his pattern of ambiguity toward far‑right endorsements.

title: Trump Says John McCain Is “Not a War Hero” Because He Was Captured
synopsis: Trump said Sen. John McCain was “not a war hero” and dismissed his status as a prisoner of war, remarking, “I like people who weren’t captured.” The comment sparked bipartisan outrage and was widely seen as an attack on military service and sacrifice. It set a pattern of demeaning veterans who criticized him.

title: Trump Attacks Megyn Kelly with “Blood” Comment After Debate
synopsis: After the first GOP debate, Trump described Fox News host Megyn Kelly as having “blood coming out of her eyes, blood coming out of her wherever.” The comment was widely criticized as sexist and degrading. It became an early flashpoint for misogynistic rhetoric in the campaign.

title: Trump Model Management Accused of Recruiting Models to Work on Tourist Visas
synopsis: A CNNMoney investigation reported that Trump Model Management recruited foreign models to work on tourist visas and used harsh control over pay and living conditions, prompting complaints to labor authorities. Attorneys for models alleged violations of U.S. immigration and labor rules. The reporting added to scrutiny of Trump‑branded business practices while he campaigned on immigration enforcement.

title: Trump SoHo Buyers Sue Over Alleged Inflated Sales Claims
synopsis: Condo‑hotel buyers at the Trump SoHo project sued, alleging marketing materials falsely claimed units were mostly sold when sales were far lower. The lawsuit asserted that inflated sales figures induced purchases at higher prices. It added to a pattern of litigation around Trump‑branded real‑estate deals.

title: Lawsuit Alleges Trump Promoted MLM Schemes (Trump Network / Trump Institute)
synopsis: A class‑action lawsuit alleged Trump promoted multi‑level marketing programs, including Trump Network and Trump Institute, that misled consumers with profit claims and training promises. The suit described the ventures as deceptive sales operations that left participants with losses. It echoed broader allegations of branding‑driven schemes marketed as business opportunities.

title: Campaign Launch: “Build the Wall” and Make Mexico Pay (June 2015)
synopsis: At his presidential campaign launch, Trump vowed to build a “great, great wall” on the southern border and said Mexico would pay for it. The statement framed immigration as a threat and turned a costly infrastructure promise into a political slogan. It became a defining plank of his campaign and fueled anti-immigrant sentiment.

title: Trump Promises “Deportation Force” to Remove 11 Million People
synopsis: Pressed on how he would deport an estimated 11 million undocumented immigrants, Trump said he would create a “deportation force” and carry out removals “humanely.” The proposal invoked mass roundups and removals on a vast scale. It drew comparisons to historical mass deportations and intensified fears in immigrant communities.

title: Trump Claims “Thousands” of Muslims Cheered 9/11 in New Jersey
synopsis: Trump told rally audiences and TV interviewers that he saw “thousands and thousands” of Muslims in New Jersey cheering the 9/11 attacks. The claim was widely debunked and officials said no such celebrations occurred. The false story inflamed anti‑Muslim sentiment and conspiracy thinking.

title: Trump Says the U.S. Should “Take Out” Terrorists’ Families
synopsis: In a Fox News interview, Trump said the U.S. should “take out” the families of terrorists as a tactic against ISIS. Legal experts and human‑rights advocates warned such actions would violate the laws of war. The comment openly endorsed collective punishment and civilian targeting.

title: Trump Vows to “Open Up” Libel Laws to Sue the Press
synopsis: At a Texas rally, Trump pledged to “open up” libel laws so he could sue news organizations and “win lots of money.” The threat was widely criticized as an attack on the First Amendment and press freedom. It foreshadowed a broader campaign to delegitimize and intimidate media outlets.

title: Trump Retweets Quote Attributed to Benito Mussolini
synopsis: Trump retweeted a quote attributed to Italian fascist dictator Benito Mussolini, saying it was better to live one day as a lion than 100 years as a sheep. When asked about it, he brushed off concerns and defended the message. The episode highlighted casual amplification of authoritarian symbolism.

title: Trump Promotes Tabloid Conspiracy About Ted Cruz’s Father and JFK
synopsis: Trump promoted a National Enquirer conspiracy suggesting Ted Cruz’s father was linked to Lee Harvey Oswald, the assassin of President John F. Kennedy. The claim was unsubstantiated and widely condemned. It exemplified his willingness to weaponize fringe conspiracy theories for political attacks.

title: Trump публично asks Russia to find Clinton’s missing emails
synopsis: At a press conference, Trump publicly urged Russia to find and release Hillary Clinton’s missing emails. The comment was widely criticized as inviting foreign interference in a U.S. election and drew condemnation from both parties. It became a defining moment in the 2016 campaign’s Russia controversy.

title: Trump Endorses Stop-and-Frisk Policing in 2016 Debate
synopsis: During the first presidential debate, Trump praised New York’s stop‑and‑frisk program and suggested its use in cities like Chicago. The tactic had been ruled unconstitutional and criticized for racial profiling. His endorsement signaled support for aggressive policing practices with disproportionate impacts on Black and Latino communities.

title: Trump Says Hillary Clinton Should Be Jailed
synopsis: At a June 2016 rally, Trump said Hillary Clinton “has to go to jail” over her email practices. The demand was echoed by “lock her up” chants and framed political opposition as criminal. The rhetoric normalized calls for prosecuting opponents and escalated authoritarian themes in the campaign.

title: 1987 Full-Page Ads Demanding Allies Pay for U.S. Defense
synopsis: Trump bought full-page newspaper ads arguing that wealthy allies like Japan and Saudi Arabia should pay the United States for military protection and that America was being taken advantage of. The ads marked an early national political pitch built around grievance and transactional foreign policy.
rationale: Promoted a transactional, resentful view of alliances as a political brand.

title: Trump Plaza Casino Fined for Removing Black Dealers
synopsis: New Jersey’s Casino Control Commission fined Trump Plaza after Black dealers were removed from tables at the request of a high-rolling customer. Regulators cited discriminatory treatment in casino operations.
rationale: Official sanction for discriminatory practices in his casino business.

title: Jill Harth Lawsuit Alleged Sexual Assault and Harassment
synopsis: In 1997, former business associate Jill Harth filed a lawsuit alleging sexual assault and harassment by Trump; he denied the allegations and the case later ended. The filing added to a record of misconduct allegations tied to his business relationships.
rationale: Court-filed allegations of sexual misconduct in a business context, denied by Trump.
subcategory: Workplace Sexual Assault and Entertainment Industry Exploitation

title: Miss Universe Moscow: Trump Courted Putin and Agalarov (2013)
synopsis: Ahead of the 2013 Miss Universe pageant in Moscow, Trump courted Russian officials and invited Vladimir Putin while working with developer Aras Agalarov. The episode highlighted early business-driven outreach to authoritarian power centers.
rationale: Shows foreign-policy posture shaped by business incentives and authoritarian outreach.

title: FinCEN Fines Trump Taj Mahal $10 Million for AML Violations
synopsis: FinCEN assessed a $10 million civil penalty against Trump Taj Mahal for willful anti-money-laundering violations, including failure to report suspicious transactions. The order cited repeated compliance failures at the casino.
rationale: Regulatory findings of serious financial compliance violations.

title: Refused to Release Tax Returns During 2016 Campaign
synopsis: Trump broke decades of precedent by refusing to release his tax returns during the 2016 campaign, citing an audit while offering no timeline. The refusal blocked public scrutiny of his finances and conflicts.
rationale: Transparency obstruction during a presidential campaign.

title: Fake Time Magazine Cover Displayed at Trump Tower
synopsis: A fake Time magazine cover praising Trump was displayed at Trump Tower; Time confirmed it was not an authentic cover. The incident reflected manufactured media credibility for branding.
rationale: Fabricated accolades to inflate public image.
subcategory: Media Fraud and False Success Narrative

title: Used Pseudonyms to Hype Wealth to Reporters
synopsis: Reporting revealed Trump used the pseudonyms "John Barron" and "John Miller" to talk to journalists and inflate his wealth and romantic storylines. The tactic aimed to manipulate press coverage and public perception.
rationale: Deliberate media manipulation to fabricate reputation.
subcategory: Media Fraud and False Success Narrative

title: Trump Foundation Veterans Fundraiser Alleged Illegal Coordination
synopsis: New York’s attorney general alleged the Trump Foundation unlawfully coordinated with Trump’s campaign in a 2016 Iowa veterans fundraiser and used charitable resources for political activity. The lawsuit cited illegal coordination and self-dealing.
rationale: Charity misuse and illegal political coordination allegations by state regulators.
subcategory: Charity Fraud and Illegal Political Donations

title: Calls for Death Penalty for Drug Dealers (2018)
synopsis: In a 2018 speech about the opioid crisis, Trump urged the death penalty for drug dealers, praising countries that execute traffickers. The remarks pushed extreme punitive measures into U.S. drug policy debate.
rationale: Advocated expanded capital punishment as policy.

title: Bonwit Teller Art Deco Demolition and Broken Donation Promise
synopsis: During demolition of the Bonwit Teller building for Trump Tower, the building’s Art Deco reliefs were destroyed after earlier assurances they would be preserved or donated. Preservationists said the destruction broke a public promise and symbolized Trump’s willingness to bulldoze cultural heritage for his project timeline.
rationale: A high-profile example of breaking preservation promises for a real-estate project.

title: “I Love the Poorly Educated” Rally Remark
synopsis: After winning the Nevada GOP caucus, Trump told supporters “I love the poorly educated,” a line that drew cheers and became a symbol of anti-intellectual populism during his campaign.
rationale: Celebrated anti-intellectual politics as a badge of honor.

title: “I Alone Can Fix It” RNC Speech
synopsis: Accepting the Republican nomination, Trump declared “I alone can fix it,” presenting himself as a singular savior figure rather than a democratic leader accountable to institutions.
rationale: Authoritarian rhetoric that elevates one leader above democratic checks.

title: Fires FBI Director James Comey
synopsis: Trump abruptly fired FBI Director James Comey, who was overseeing the Russia investigation, triggering accusations of obstruction and an abuse of presidential power.
rationale: Removed the official leading an investigation into his campaign’s Russia ties.

title: Withdraws the U.S. from the Paris Climate Agreement
synopsis: Trump announced the United States would withdraw from the Paris climate accord, rejecting a central global framework for cutting emissions.
rationale: Undermined global climate cooperation and U.S. credibility on emissions cuts.

title: Announces Transgender Military Ban by Tweet
synopsis: Trump declared by tweet that the U.S. would not allow transgender people to serve in the military, abruptly reversing policy and triggering legal challenges.
rationale: Targeted transgender service members and disrupted military policy by fiat.

title: Ends DACA Program for Dreamers
synopsis: The administration announced it would end DACA, the program protecting undocumented immigrants brought to the U.S. as children, jeopardizing hundreds of thousands of Dreamers.
rationale: Revoked protections for a vulnerable population raised in the U.S.
subcategory: Legal Immigration Status Revocation and Humanitarian Protection Elimination

title: Retweets Britain First Anti-Muslim Videos
synopsis: Trump retweeted anti-Muslim videos from the far-right British group Britain First, amplifying extremist propaganda and sparking international backlash.
rationale: Boosted a hate group’s content from the presidential account.

title: “Shithole Countries” Remark
synopsis: In a White House immigration meeting, Trump reportedly referred to Haiti and African nations as “shithole countries,” a remark condemned as racist and degrading.
rationale: Dehumanizing language about countries of color in policy discussions.

title: Withdraws from the Iran Nuclear Deal (JCPOA)
synopsis: Trump announced the U.S. would exit the Iran nuclear agreement (JCPOA), reimposing sanctions and escalating tensions with Iran and U.S. allies.
rationale: Pulled the U.S. out of a multilateral nonproliferation accord.

title: “Take the Guns First, Go Through Due Process Second”
synopsis: At a White House meeting on guns, Trump said authorities should “take the guns first, go through due process second,” endorsing seizures before legal protections.
rationale: Called for bypassing due process rights in gun seizures.

title: U.S. Withdraws from U.N. Human Rights Council
synopsis: The administration announced the U.S. would leave the U.N. Human Rights Council, a move criticized as abandoning global human-rights leadership.
rationale: Withdrew from an international human-rights body.
subcategory: Universal Human Rights Elimination and Constitutional Protection Destruction

title: Revolutionary War “Airports” Gaffe
synopsis: During a Fourth of July speech, Trump praised Revolutionary War troops for “manning the air, it rammed the ramparts, it took over the airports,” a historically impossible claim that drew ridicule.
rationale: Public gaffe showing historical ignorance on a national stage.

title: Floats Buying Greenland
synopsis: Reports said Trump had discussed the idea of the United States buying Greenland, an idea dismissed by Danish officials and widely criticized as a colonial-style fantasy.
rationale: Treating sovereign territory as a real-estate purchase echoed imperialist thinking.

title: Urges China to Investigate the Bidens
synopsis: Trump publicly suggested that China should investigate Joe Biden and his son, inviting foreign interference in a U.S. election.
rationale: Solicited foreign involvement in domestic electoral politics.

title: Announces U.S. Withdrawal from the WHO
synopsis: Trump announced the United States would withdraw from the World Health Organization during the COVID‑19 pandemic, a move criticized for undermining global public-health coordination.
rationale: Pulled out of a key health body in the middle of a pandemic.

title: Suggests Delaying the 2020 Election
synopsis: Trump publicly floated delaying the 2020 election, a proposal widely rejected as unconstitutional and authoritarian.
rationale: Questioned the scheduled democratic transfer of power.

title: “Person, Woman, Man, Camera, TV” Cognitive Test Brag
synopsis: Trump repeatedly bragged about acing a basic cognitive test, reciting “person, woman, man, camera, TV” as proof of fitness, drawing ridicule and concern about his focus on the test.
rationale: Public gaffe highlighting fixation on a basic screening test.

title: Stares at Solar Eclipse Without Eye Protection
synopsis: During the 2017 solar eclipse, Trump was photographed looking directly at the sun without protective glasses, a moment widely criticized as reckless and emblematic of disregard for basic safety guidance.
rationale: Highly public disregard for basic safety warnings.

title: Calls for “Termination” of the Constitution
synopsis: After the “Twitter Files” discussion, Trump posted that the “Constitution should be terminated” to address perceived election grievances, drawing broad condemnation for authoritarian rhetoric.
rationale: Advocated ending constitutional protections to overturn election results.

title: Fires Acting AG Sally Yates for Refusing Travel Ban Defense
synopsis: After Sally Yates directed the Justice Department not to defend the travel ban, Trump fired the acting attorney general, triggering warnings about retaliation against DOJ independence.
rationale: Removed the acting attorney general after she refused to defend the travel ban.

title: Withdraws U.S. from the Trans-Pacific Partnership
synopsis: Trump signed a memorandum directing the United States to withdraw as a signatory to the Trans-Pacific Partnership, reversing participation in the multilateral trade pact.
rationale: Pulled the U.S. from a major multilateral trade agreement on day one.

title: Revives Keystone XL Pipeline
synopsis: Trump signed a presidential memorandum inviting Keystone XL to proceed, reversing the prior halt to the cross-border oil pipeline.
rationale: Prioritized fossil fuel expansion despite environmental concerns.
subcategory: Fossil Fuel Expansion and Climate Science Elimination

title: Orders Dakota Access Pipeline to Proceed
synopsis: Trump signed a memorandum directing agencies to expedite review and approval of the Dakota Access Pipeline after its prior delay.
rationale: Fast-tracked the pipeline despite environmental and tribal objections.
subcategory: Public Lands Resource Extraction and Environmental Protection Elimination

title: Pressures Comey to Drop Flynn Investigation
synopsis: In a private Oval Office conversation, Trump told FBI Director James Comey he hoped the bureau would let the Michael Flynn investigation go.
rationale: Sought to impede an investigation involving a close adviser.

title: Shares Classified Intelligence with Russian Officials
synopsis: Trump disclosed highly classified intelligence to Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov and Ambassador Sergey Kislyak in the Oval Office, alarming U.S. allies and intelligence officials.
rationale: Revealed sensitive intelligence to Russian officials, risking sources and methods.

title: Admits 'Russia Thing' Behind Comey Firing
synopsis: In an NBC interview, Trump said he was thinking about "this Russia thing" when he decided to fire FBI Director James Comey, undercutting the official rationale.
rationale: Linked the Comey firing to the Russia investigation in a televised interview.

title: Calls NFL Protesters 'Sons of Bitches'
synopsis: At an Alabama rally, Trump said NFL owners should fire players who knelt during the anthem, calling them "sons of bitches."
rationale: Used abusive rhetoric to encourage retaliation against peaceful protest.

title: Withdraws U.S. from UNESCO
synopsis: The State Department announced the U.S. would withdraw from UNESCO, reducing U.S. participation in the UN cultural agency.
rationale: Pulled the U.S. from a major UN organization focused on education and culture.

title: Pulls U.S. from Global Compact on Migration Talks
synopsis: The Trump administration withdrew the U.S. from the UN Global Compact on Migration process, rejecting the international migration framework.
rationale: Abandoned the multilateral migration compact process.

title: Recognizes Jerusalem as Israel's Capital
synopsis: Trump formally recognized Jerusalem as Israel's capital and directed the State Department to begin moving the U.S. embassy.
rationale: Unilaterally recognized Jerusalem as Israel's capital and ordered embassy relocation.

title: FCC Repeals Net Neutrality Under Trump Appointees
synopsis: The Trump-era FCC voted to repeal the 2015 net neutrality rules, rolling back federal protections for open internet access.
rationale: Regulatory rollback favored broadband providers by ending net neutrality rules.

title: Denies Puerto Rico Hurricane Death Toll
synopsis: Trump claimed the Hurricane Maria death toll in Puerto Rico was inflated, disputing official estimates after a major study pegged deaths near 3,000.
rationale: Disputed official disaster death toll figures instead of acknowledging the scale of loss.

title: Launches 'Remain in Mexico' Asylum Policy
synopsis: DHS announced the Migrant Protection Protocols, requiring certain asylum seekers to wait in Mexico for their U.S. immigration proceedings.
rationale: Forced asylum seekers to remain in Mexico while their cases were processed.
subcategory: Refugee and Asylum Protection System Elimination

title: Withdraws from the INF Nuclear Treaty
synopsis: Trump announced the U.S. would suspend obligations under the INF Treaty and begin the process of withdrawal, ending a major arms-control pact with Russia.
rationale: Ended a landmark nuclear arms-control treaty.

title: Recognizes Israeli Sovereignty over the Golan Heights
synopsis: Trump signed a proclamation recognizing the Golan Heights as part of Israel, reversing decades of U.S. policy on the disputed territory.
rationale: Unilaterally recognized Israeli sovereignty over the Golan Heights.

title: Orders Withdrawal from Northern Syria, Abandoning Kurdish Allies
synopsis: Trump ordered U.S. troops to withdraw from northern Syria, a move that enabled a Turkish offensive against Kurdish forces aligned with the U.S. fight against ISIS.
rationale: Abruptly pulled U.S. forces from northern Syria, weakening allied partners.

title: Expands 'Public Charge' Rule for Green Cards
synopsis: USCIS published the DHS final rule broadening public charge criteria, making it harder for immigrants who used public benefits to obtain permanent residency.
rationale: Expanded public charge criteria to restrict immigration eligibility.

title: Announces U.S. Exit from Open Skies Treaty
synopsis: The Trump administration announced it would withdraw from the Open Skies Treaty, ending U.S. participation in the aerial surveillance pact.
rationale: Withdrew from another major arms-control and transparency agreement.

title: Tweets 'LIBERATE' to Encourage Anti-Lockdown Protests
synopsis: Trump tweeted "LIBERATE MICHIGAN", "LIBERATE MINNESOTA", and "LIBERATE VIRGINIA", cheering protests against COVID-19 restrictions in Democratic-led states.
rationale: Encouraged unrest against state public health measures during the pandemic.

title: Says He Wanted COVID Testing 'Slowed Down'
synopsis: At a Tulsa rally, Trump said he told his team to slow down COVID-19 testing, arguing that more tests meant more reported cases.
rationale: Undercut public health response by discouraging testing.

title: Orders Census Apportionment Excluding Undocumented Immigrants
synopsis: Trump issued a memorandum directing that undocumented immigrants be excluded from the apportionment base following the 2020 census.
rationale: Sought to alter representation by excluding undocumented residents from apportionment.

title: Bans Federal Diversity Training on Race and Sex Stereotyping
synopsis: Trump signed Executive Order 13950 restricting federal diversity training and prohibiting certain concepts in federal workplaces and contracts.
rationale: Used executive power to restrict anti-racism training in government and contractors.

title: Refuses to Commit to Peaceful Transfer of Power
synopsis: When asked if he would accept a peaceful transfer of power after the 2020 election, Trump refused to commit and blamed mail ballots.
rationale: Undermined a core democratic norm by refusing to commit to a peaceful transfer.

title: Says He Would Let Russia Attack NATO Members Who 'Don't Pay'
synopsis: At a 2024 rally, Trump said he would encourage Russia to do whatever it wanted to NATO allies that did not meet defense spending targets.
rationale: Threatened collective defense commitments and emboldened adversaries.

title: Creates Presidential Advisory Commission on Election Integrity
synopsis: Signed an executive order creating the Presidential Advisory Commission on Election Integrity, led by Vice President Pence and Kris Kobach, to investigate claims of voter fraud.
rationale: Established a federal commission to investigate voter fraud claims and election data.

title: Kobach Requests Nationwide Voter Data for Commission
synopsis: Commission vice chair Kris Kobach sent letters to states requesting voter rolls and personal data for the Election Integrity Commission.
rationale: Sought extensive voter data from states through the commission.
subcategory: Systematic Voter Suppression and Electoral Manipulation

title: Rescinds Transgender Student Protections Guidance
synopsis: The Departments of Education and Justice withdrew Obama-era guidance that protected transgender students access to facilities.
rationale: Removed federal guidance safeguarding transgender students in schools.

title: Orders Review of Waters of the United States Rule
synopsis: Signed an executive order directing agencies to review and rescind or revise the 2015 WOTUS clean water rule.
rationale: Set in motion rollback of clean water protections.

title: EPA Proposes Repeal of the Clean Power Plan
synopsis: EPA announced a proposed repeal of the Clean Power Plan, reversing the Obama-era climate rule for power plants.
rationale: Moved to dismantle a major federal climate rule.

title: Shrinks Bears Ears and Grand Staircase-Escalante
synopsis: Signed proclamations reducing Bears Ears and Grand Staircase-Escalante national monuments in Utah.
rationale: Cut protections for major public lands and sacred sites.
subcategory: Public Lands Resource Extraction and Environmental Protection Elimination

title: Ends ACA Cost-Sharing Reduction Payments
synopsis: The administration stopped federal CSR payments to insurers under the Affordable Care Act.
rationale: Cut subsidies that reduced out-of-pocket costs for low-income enrollees.
subcategory: Social Safety Net Destruction and Vulnerable Population Abandonment

title: Ends U.S. Funding for UNRWA
synopsis: The State Department announced the U.S. would end funding for the U.N. agency for Palestinian refugees.
rationale: Cut humanitarian funding for Palestinian refugees.
subcategory: Refugee and Asylum Protection System Elimination

title: Orders Closure of PLO Office in Washington
synopsis: The State Department ordered the Palestine Liberation Organization office in Washington, D.C. to close.
rationale: Shut down a key Palestinian diplomatic presence in the U.S.

title: Sets Refugee Admissions Cap at 18,000
synopsis: Issued a determination setting the FY2020 refugee admissions ceiling at 18,000.
rationale: Lowered refugee admissions to a record low level.
subcategory: Refugee and Asylum Protection System Elimination

title: Bans Asylum for Migrants Crossing Between Ports
synopsis: The administration announced a rule to bar asylum for migrants who crossed the border outside ports of entry.
rationale: Restricted access to asylum based on entry location.
subcategory: Refugee and Asylum Protection System Elimination

title: Imposes Third-Country Transit Asylum Ban
synopsis: DHS and DOJ issued a rule barring asylum for migrants who did not seek protection in a third country during transit.
rationale: Created a transit bar to asylum for most migrants.
subcategory: Refugee and Asylum Protection System Elimination

title: Signs Asylum Cooperative Agreement with Guatemala
synopsis: Guatemala signed a "safe third country" asylum cooperative agreement with the U.S. after Trump pressure.
rationale: Pushed asylum seekers to seek protection in Guatemala instead of the U.S.
subcategory: Refugee and Asylum Protection System Elimination

title: Calls MS-13 Members "Animals" in Immigration Remarks
synopsis: At a White House roundtable, Trump referred to MS-13 members as "animals" while discussing immigration enforcement.
rationale: Used dehumanizing rhetoric about immigrants in a public setting.
subcategory: Immigrant Dehumanization and Xenophobic Campaign Launch

title: Tells Four Congresswomen to "Go Back"
synopsis: Trump tweeted that four Democratic congresswomen should return to the countries they came from.
rationale: Used xenophobic rhetoric to attack U.S. lawmakers of color.
subcategory: Immigrant Dehumanization and Xenophobic Campaign Launch

title: Reverses U.S. Position on Israeli Settlements
synopsis: Secretary of State Pompeo announced the U.S. would no longer view Israeli settlements as illegal.
rationale: Shifted U.S. policy to favor Israeli settlements.

title: DOJ Overrides Prosecutors on Roger Stone Sentencing
synopsis: After Trump criticized the sentencing recommendation, DOJ moved to reduce prosecutors' request and four prosecutors withdrew.
rationale: Interfered in sentencing of a close ally through DOJ actions.

title: DOJ Moves to Drop Michael Flynn Case
synopsis: The Justice Department filed a motion to dismiss the criminal case against former national security adviser Michael Flynn.
rationale: DOJ sought to end prosecution of a Trump ally.

title: Pardons Michael Flynn
synopsis: Trump granted a full pardon to former national security adviser Michael Flynn.
rationale: Issued clemency to a close ally.

title: Pardons Paul Manafort
synopsis: Trump granted a pardon to former campaign chairman Paul Manafort.
rationale: Issued clemency to a key campaign associate convicted in the Russia probe.

title: Pardons Steve Bannon
synopsis: Trump pardoned former adviser Steve Bannon in his final hours in office.
rationale: Issued clemency to a close ally facing federal charges.

title: Threatens North Korea with "Fire and Fury"
synopsis: Trump warned North Korea it would be met with "fire and fury like the world has never seen."
rationale: Escalated nuclear tensions with inflammatory threats.
